sections.heading: CEPT University vs Silver Oak University for M.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: This page cannot name a placement winner, because neither university has an M.Tech placement record in our database.

Choose CEPT if you want a specialist Ahmedabad campus and have budgeted for recorded tuition of ₹3.20 lakh a year, plus an other charge of ₹25,000. Choose Silver Oak if recorded year tuition of ₹90,000 is the first filter, after you confirm the official notice.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: CEPT University has recorded M.Tech tuition of ₹3.20 lakh a year and an other charge of ₹25,000. Treat the tuition as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed two-year total, until you check CEPT's official circular.
Silver Oak University has recorded tuition of ₹90,000 a year. That is much lower than CEPT in our records. Confirm both official notices for the exact specialisation you will join.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Neither side has a placement row on this page. Do not assume a package that we do not hold.
Ask each university for its latest official M.Tech or postgraduate placement report, and compare the same graduating year.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Neither side has an entrance exam listed in our records on this page. M.Tech admissions may use GATE, a university test, or a sponsored-seat process, depending on the programme.
Read the current official admissions page of each university for eligibility and specialisations.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on different sites. CEPT is a specialist university for architecture, planning and related technology. Silver Oak is a private university campus.
Visit both if studio or lab facilities will decide the choice. The city is the same; the recorded year tuition is not.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If recorded year tuition is your first filter, Silver Oak University is lower in our records, at ₹90,000 against CEPT's ₹3.20 lakh.
If you want CEPT's specialist campus, budget from its official circular, not from a guessed two-year total, and ask for a current placement report.
